title: Regional Proration Methods and the Billed Share of an Optional Coverage Add-Ons Rider Term
content:
**Rate schedule extract.** For a rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons, the corrected billed share of the rider's term, used for its premium billing correction, follows the proration method in Bridgewell's rider rate schedule for the region where the base homeowner property lies. The region is read from the property ZIP code recorded on the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract.

In each method, the rider's start is the later of the term start date and the add date.

| Property ZIP code | Proration method in the rider rate schedule | Corrected billed share |
|---|---|---|
| 43000 through 49999 (Ohio, Indiana and Michigan) | Every started month of the rider's term is billed | The whole months from the rider's start to the term end date, plus one, divided by twelve |
| 73000 through 79999 (Oklahoma and Texas) | Only completed months are billed | The whole months from the rider's start to the term end date, divided by twelve |
| Any other ZIP code | Day count | The days from the rider's start through the term end date, both days counted, divided by the days from the term start date through the term end date, both days counted |

## Worked figures (hypothetical dates)

A rider added on 2 July to a base term running 1 January through 31 December (365 days). The rider's start is 2 July; the whole months from 2 July to 31 December are 5.

| Property ZIP code | Corrected billed share |
|---|---|
| 44101 | 5 plus one, divided by twelve: 0.5 |
| 75201 | 5 divided by twelve: about 0.4167 |
| 30301 | 183 divided by 365: about 0.5014 |

## Range edges

- ZIP codes 43000 and 49999 are inside the first range; 42999 and 50000 are not.
- ZIP codes 73000 and 79999 are inside the second range; 72999 and 80000 are not.
